items.title: Vibe Coded AO3 Clone Site Down After Fanfic Authors Buried It With 2,000 Takedown Notices in a Single Day
items.excerpt: ao3.life scraped Archive of Our Own fanfiction and repackaged it as AI-narrated audiobooks for sale without authors' permission; fanfic writers filed some 2,000 takedown notices in a day and the site went down.

items.title: University Presses Back AI Service Meridian
items.excerpt: Cambridge, Johns Hopkins and Princeton university presses are founding publishers of Meridian, an AI gateway run by licensing start-up Cashmere that gives students and researchers licensed AI access to peer-reviewed books and journals.

items.title: Author who admitted using AI wins France's top literary prize
items.excerpt: Philippe Jaenada won the 2026 Prix Goncourt for a novel that incorporates his research conversations with ChatGPT and Claude, weeks after a front-runner was dropped over AI allegations and the Academie said it would bar AI-aided works.

items.title: Copyright Infringement Lawsuit Against OpenAI Draws More than 50 (Very Illuminating) Amicus Briefs
items.excerpt: More than 50 amicus briefs filed in the authors' copyright case against OpenAI map the fault lines of the most closely watched AI fair-use lawsuit and what it means for books.

items.title: AI platform wins publishing award in Sharjah
items.excerpt: Brazilian platform KlooBR, which uses AI to edit, translate and proofread books in minutes, won the Disrupt Track award from Sharjah's Publishing Sustainability Fund.

items.title: Sign of the Times: What is an (AI) author?
items.excerpt: A Stanford Daily column asks what authorship means when AI agents can write papers, separating plagiarism from the question of whether an AI can be an 'author'.

items.title: '인간이 썼습니다'가 경쟁력⋯AI 시대, 책의 가치가 바뀐다 [AI가 쓰는 시대 ③]
items.excerpt: AI 집필이 확산하자 출판사들은 계약·검증을 강화하고, AI 집필 의혹에 출간을 취소하는 사례도 나오며, 작가단체는 '사람이 쓴 책' 인증제를 도입하고 있다.

items.title: "AI로 그린 인생, 그림책으로 꽃피우다"…사상구 어르신 13명, 생애 첫 그림책 작가로 우뚝
items.excerpt: 부산 사상구 어르신 13명이 생성형 AI를 활용해 자신의 삶을 담은 그림책을 완성하고 작가로 독자와 만났다.

items.title: Google testing Comic Artifacts for Gemini Notebook
items.excerpt: A hidden beta tile in Gemini Notebook reveals a Comics artifact that turns notes into comics in Default, Shojo, Chibi and Fantasy Anime styles; not yet public.

items.title: Why the AI Detection Scandals Will End—Probably Quite Soon
items.excerpt: Jane Friedman argues 2026's wave of AI-use allegations against authors stems from books acquired before publishers adopted detection tools like Pangram, so the scandals should fade.

items.title: Guest Post - Freed from Thinking: Protecting Scholarly Publishing from the Slow Erosion of Human Judgment
items.excerpt: A Scholarly Kitchen guest post argues that if scholarly publishing is to be worth anything in a generation, publishers must acknowledge the risks of relying on AI and intelligent automation in place of human judgment.

items.title: Guest Post - What Accessibility at Scale Actually Requires of Academic Publishers
items.excerpt: Academic publishers sitting on decades of archives can use AI to audit non-compliant content and generate alt-text, structural tags and metadata to make backlists accessible at scale.

items.title: Book Piracy Is Going Automated as Publishers Fight Back
items.excerpt: Anti-piracy enforcement against shadow libraries is now largely automated, while a publisher complaint alleges a pirate site sold bulk access to 140 million texts to LLM developers.

items.title: Gruffalo illustrator considering legal action against AI firms
items.excerpt: Axel Scheffler says AI firms breach copyright by reproducing his style in AI-generated Gruffalo images and is weighing legal action.

items.title: [단독] 앤트로픽 '책 도둑질' 한국 피해 저자 250명…한강·황석영도 보상 '산 넘어 산'
items.excerpt: 앤트로픽의 도서 700만권 무단 다운로드로 피해를 입은 국내 저자가 약 250명으로 파악됐지만 실제 보상을 받을 저자는 극히 드물 전망이다.

items.title: Artificial Intelligence is a Horror Story
items.excerpt: A Lit Hub essay traces how horror and speculative literature have long imagined disembodied machine intelligence, reading today's AI through that literary tradition.

items.title: Toonsutra Bets on AI to Turn Comics Into Cinema With Its Cinematic Mode
items.excerpt: Indian webcomics platform Toonsutra's Cinematic Mode uses Google's Veo 3, Gemini and Lyria to animate, voice and score comics.

items.title: One-Punch Man Artist Yusuke Murata Calls Generative AI "The Best Teacher," Sparking Debate Among Fans
items.excerpt: One-Punch Man illustrator Yusuke Murata called generative AI 'the best teacher', sparking fan debate given the manga's celebrated hand-drawn art.

items.title: "딸깍도서 넘쳐날수록 출판산업 보호해야"… 출판계, 세제 혜택 촉구
items.excerpt: AI로 손쉽게 찍어내는 '딸깍출판'이 늘고 AI 기업의 출판물 학습이 확대되자 출판단체가 편집·디자인·인세 비용까지 포함한 출판콘텐츠 세액공제를 요구했다.

items.title: 사람이 책을 만들고, 책이 AI를 만든다
items.excerpt: 해외 업체들이 교보문고에서 한국어 책을 대량 구매해 AI 학습 데이터로 쓰는 가운데, 책의 AI 학습 이용 대가 기준이 없는 문제를 짚는다.

items.title: Lagos' Ake Festival 2026 to explore AI, native intelligence, allegations against black writers
items.excerpt: Ake Arts and Book Festival (Nov 19-21, Lagos) will hold panels on AI and creativity and on AI-use allegations against Black writers.

items.title: 출판계에 닥친 AI발 위기…"산업 기반 무너뜨릴 수도"
items.excerpt: 앤트로픽의 대규모 서적 무단 확보가 드러나며 출판계에 AI발 위기가 확인되고 있다는 진단과 업계 대응을 다룬다.

items.title: Fergus Morgan on AI's disruption of audio drama
items.excerpt: On World Audio Drama Day, Fergus Morgan examines how AI voices are disrupting the audio drama sector and how The Speakies awards celebrate human creativity.

items.title: 김유정문학촌, AI 시대 스토리 창작의 윤리 묻는다…11월 14일 포럼
items.excerpt: 김유정문학촌이 11월 14일 생성형 AI와 스토리 창작의 관계, 저작권·문체 변화를 논의하는 포럼을 연다.

items.title: 한국출판인회의, AI 시대 출판 논의하는 '2026 아시아 출판 주간' 개최
items.excerpt: 한국출판인회의가 아시아 각 지역 출판인을 초청해 AI 시대 출판의 방향을 모색하는 '2026 아시아 출판 주간'을 연다.
